title: Grilled Hoisin Tofu
subtitle: with Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Here's a midweek meal made easy: protein-rich tofu marinated in tangy hoisin sauce, grilled until golden and sticky and served with veggie-packed fried rice.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the grill to medium-high. Bring 1L (4 cups) water to the boil in a medium saucepan. Remove the tofu, according to the packet instructions, and drain on paper towel for at least 5 mins. Wipe the mushrooms clean, then cut into wedges. Peel and thinly slice the carrots. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves.
Cook rice: Cook the rice in the pan of boiling water for 12 mins or until tender. Drain, return to the pan and cover to keep warm.
Grill tofu: Meanwhile, cut the tofu horizontally into 2 pieces, put in a shallow ovenproof dish and pour over half the hoisin sauce. Grill for 6-8 mins until bubbling and sticky.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 1½ tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms, coriander stems and garlic, stirring, for 2-3 mins until browned. Add the carrot and cook, stirring, for a further 3-4 mins until almost tender.

Serve up: Add the rice, remaining hoisin sauce, 1 tsp white vinegar, 1 tsp honey and 2 tsp soy sauce. Stir-fry for a further 1-2 mins until warmed through. Taste, then season with pepper. Divide the fried rice among plates, top with the hoisin tofu, scatter with the coriander leaves and enjoy.
Make it yours: Scatter some chilli flakes or fresh chilli over the top before serving for a little burst of heat.
